content.text: {"headline":"Recommend no action (P0): service is predicted at 87.1% over 11:30-13:30, above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"General's handle time has roughly doubled since 10:30 (about 345 s up to 644-705 s, against a forecast of about 370 s). This is most likely because knowledge-base search is timing out (INC-20261104-2401). That link is likely but not confirmed, as the ticket was opened an hour after handle time rose. Calls are running 8-14% below forecast, which is absorbing much of the impact. Even with no changes, the predicted service level for 11:30-13:30 is 87.1% (payments 88.9%, general 84.5%), with 2.6% abandons and 93.2% for the rest of the day. Every queue clears the 80% target, so no intervention is needed.","trade_offs":["P1 (no cost: lend payments staff, delay breaks, callback) predicts 86.7% overall and 83.4% on general. That is slightly worse than doing nothing, and it adds disruption for agents.","P2 (chat deflection plus agent moves, ₹276) gives the best gain per rupee: 88.8% overall, general 85.6%, abandons 2.2%. It also keeps payments up at 91.0%. It is the best fallback if general starts to slip.","P3 (₹276, uses the last of the overtime budget) gives the highest result: 89.6% overall, general 86.7%, abandons 2.1%. It also delays breaks and spends remaining overtime, leaving no reserve for later in the day.","None of the plans break policy, and moving staff out of payments does not pull payments below target in any option."],"watch":"Watch general's handle time and the INC-20261104-2401 ticket. General has the smallest margin at 84.5%. If call volume climbs back to forecast or handle time rises further, switch to P2. If the KB fix lands, handle time should fall back toward about 370 s, which would confirm the cause."}
